subject: Scheduling: swing windows for technical deep-dive (recurring rota)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@brightclass.com>, Markus Berg <mberg@finila.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed swing windows for technical deep-dive

Hi Sophie / Markus —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a proposed next step:

Summary (very high level)
- Primary use case: BrightClass wants low-latency, private inference for student-facing Q&A and automated grading hooks.
- Compliance: EU data residency for student PII required; APAC pilot expected later.
- Traffic shape: spiky during weekday mornings in APAC and late afternoons in US; steady background embedding batch jobs.

Next step: technical deep-dive with our infra and SE team (40–50 min). Because your stakeholders are distributed (US product, EU data team, APAC ops), we propose a recurring "swing window" rota so the meeting time rotates across zones week-to-week. That keeps both the engineering and product reps included over time without forcing the same office to always take late/early slots.

Proposed recurring options (pick one):
A) US-friendly week: Tue 10:30–11:10 PT / Wed 18:30–19:10 CET / Wed 02:30–03:10 SGT (works well for US mornings and EU evenings)
B) EU-first week: Thu 08:00–08:40 CET / Thu 23:00–23:40 PT / Fri 15:00–15:40 SGT (EU morning; rotates cost to US evening)
C) APAC-forward week (less frequent): Fri 16:30–17:10 SGT / Fri 01:30–02:10 CET / Thu 17:30–18:10 PT (APAC-friendly)

Attached: mutual_action_plan.pdf (one-pager with names and ownership). Also adding a draft agenda: technical-deep-dive-agenda.docx will follow from Aditya — covers sequence: infra overview, sample workload playback, SLOs, and quantization options.

Calendly (for individual exceptions): https://calendly.com/redwood/tech-deep-dive
HubSpot: HS-4829

Ask: can you confirm which recurring cadence you'd prefer (A / B / C) and whether you need meeting invites to recur for a 6-week pilot? If none of these slots work, share up to three preferred weekly windows and we'll assemble the rota.

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: mutual_action_plan.pdf (one-pager)

From: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@brightclass.com>

Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 20:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed swing windows for technical deep-dive

Tessa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Happy to move forward with a recurring rota; option B looks closest for our EU team. A few notes from our side:
- EU data team (Leads: Ingrid & Paolo) prefers mornings CET; option B's Thu 08:00 CET fits.
- Product engineering in US (Markus) can do Thu 23:00 PT occasionally but would prefer rotating so it's not always at night.
- APAC ops (me) can join the occasional Friday APAC-friendly slot but can't do late-night CET slots more than once a month.

Can we try a 6-week pilot with the following pattern?
Week 1: Option B (EU-first)
Week 2: Option A (US-friendly)
Week 3: Option A
Week 4: Option B
Week 5: Option C (APAC-forward)
Week 6: Option A

Also: please include an explicit attendee list (we'll RSVP only for core participants). If you can map which internal Redwood attendees will join each week (SE vs infra lead), that'd be perfect.

One request: can the meeting be 40 minutes (not 50) — we need a 10-minute buffer for overlapping teams.

I'll flag HS-4829 and follow-up with our procurement lead if we need to align on any security docs before the deep-dive.

Best,
Sophie
Sophie Chen
Head of Ops, BrightClass
